chapter.heading: Christian Liberty
chapter.v:
Stand fast
therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and do not be entangled again with a yoke of bondage. [Eph. 1:1]

Indeed I,
Paul, say to you that if you become circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing. [1 Cor. 4:17]

And I
testify again to every man who becomes circumcised that he is a debtor to keep the whole law. [1 Cor. 1:4; Eph.]

You have
become estranged from Christ, you who attempt to be justified by law; you have fallen from grace. [Eph. 1:15]

For we
through the Spirit eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness by faith. [[1 Pet. 1:4]]

For in
Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails anything, but faith working through love.Love Fulfills the Law [Matt. 24:14]

You ran
well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth? [1 Cor. 4:1, 2;] [Col. 4:12; Philem.]

This persuasion
does not come from Him who calls you. [Rom. 15:30]

A little
leaven leavens the whole lump. [Eph. 1:15-17]

I have
confidence in you, in the Lord, that you will have no other mind; but he who troubles you shall bear his judgment, whoever he is. [Eph. 4:1; Phil.]

And I,
brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why do I still suffer persecution? Then the offense of the cross has ceased. [[Eph. 3:16;]

I could
wish that those who trouble you would even cut themselves off!

For you,
brethren, have been called to liberty; only do not use liberty as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.

For all
the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

But if
you bite and devour one another, beware lest you be consumed by one another!Walking in the Spirit [2 Cor. 4:4;]

I say
then: Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh. [John 1:3;]

For the
flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, so that you do not do the things that you wish. [[John 17:5]]

But if
you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law. [1 Cor. 11:3;]

Now the
works of the flesh are evident, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lewdness, [John 1:16]

idolatry, sorcery,
hatred, contentions, jealousies, outbursts of wrath, selfish ambitions, dissensions, heresies, [Rom. 5:1;]

envy, murders,
drunkenness, revelries, and the like; of which I tell you beforehand, just as I also told you in time past, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God. [[Eph. 2:1]]

But the
fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, [2 Cor. 5:18;]

gentleness, self-control.
Against such there is no law. [Eph. 3:17;]

And those
who are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires. [2 Cor. 7:4]

If we
live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit. [Gal. 2:7]

Let us
not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another. [[1 Cor. 2:7]]
